correctness.rationale: For distinct deletion outputs z,z′ of word w, any symbol absent from either output was deleted at its sole occurrence, hence it cannot be absent from both different outputs; therefore supp(z) union supp(z′)=supp(w). Independently parsed the *actual* certificates.json Git blob and rebuilt every canonical graph directly from all words and their distinct deletion sets. In each of seven cases, verified every independent-set witness, all matching edges were genuine conflicts, all matching vertices disjoint and alpha+matching=#vertices. Exact certified alpha rows: n3 k1,2,3 ->1,4,3; n4 k1,2,3,4 ->1,8,18,12. A matching of size v-alpha gives the upper bound, independent set the lower bound. Binomial expansion yields the two formulas for ALL q>=2; finite support graphs are exhaustively certified independently of the alphabet parameter. No claims for n>=5 or identical outputs.
